claim: A game that makes sound through the ROM needs the original .z80 on a 48K machine as its pace control: NextZXOS's ROM3 BEEP runs 12% faster than Sinclair's, so the plain .nex is not a faithful baseline.

evidence.text: Pace control is the original .z80 on 48K, not the plain .nex: NextZXOS ROM3 BEEP (ROM 0x03F8) runs 12% faster than Sinclair's.
